scenario.zh: 同一產品有不同使用理由，需要先整理訊息方向。
scenario.en: One product serves different needs; the team needs message directions.

steps.zh: 按使用情境整理回饋
steps.en: Group feedback by use situation

steps.zh: 保留原話，另外標示推測
steps.en: Keep customer wording and label assumptions separately

steps.zh: 列出訊息方向與還要問的問題
steps.en: Draft message directions and remaining questions

input.zh: 三則虛構訪談：兩人提到月底整理報表花時間；一人擔心資料權限。
input.en: Three fictional interviews: two mention time spent on month-end reports; one worries about access controls.

output.zh: 可討論方向：減少整理工作、讓資料使用更清楚。只有三則回饋，不能推論整體市場比例；需再確認各情境。
output.en: Possible directions: reduce preparation work and clarify data access. Three comments cannot establish market proportions; confirm the situations further.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准的活動資料與去識別回饋；不自行取得個資或發布內容。
permissions.en: Use approved campaign data and de-identified feedback; do not collect personal data or publish content.

stop.zh: 回饋來源或使用同意不明時先排除；缺少證據的訊息標為假設。
stop.en: Exclude feedback with unclear provenance or consent; label unsupported messages as hypotheses.

scenario.zh: 行銷準備把活動想法交給文案與設計。
scenario.en: Marketing needs to hand a campaign idea to copywriters and designers.

steps.zh: 確認活動目標與讀者情境
steps.en: Confirm the objective and audience situation

steps.zh: 整理主訊息、素材格式與可用依據
steps.en: Define the message, formats and available support

steps.zh: 列出禁用宣稱與審核人
steps.en: List prohibited claims and the reviewer

input.zh: 虛構活動：介紹報表整理功能；受眾為營運人員；品牌禁止未經驗證的節省百分比。
input.en: Fictional campaign: introduce report preparation features to operations staff; unverified percentage savings are prohibited.

output.zh: 素材需求：一張流程示意圖、一段功能介紹。主訊息為「集中整理報表資料」。不可寫「節省 80% 工時」；由品牌負責人審核。
output.en: Brief: one process illustration and one feature description. Message: “Organize report data in one place.” Do not claim “80% time savings”; obtain brand-owner review.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准的活動資料與去識別回饋；不自行取得個資或發布內容。
permissions.en: Use approved campaign data and de-identified feedback; do not collect personal data or publish content.

stop.zh: 主張找不到依據或活動目標不明時，退回補充，不直接製作可發布內容。
stop.en: Return for clarification when claims lack support or the objective is unclear; do not create publication-ready content.

scope.zh: 僅作內容研究與撰稿方法的閱讀線索；不代表已包含品牌審核。
scope.en: A reading lead for research and drafting methods only; brand review is not established.

scenario.zh: 預算有限，需要比較通路分配，而不是猜哪個一定有效。
scenario.en: A limited budget requires comparing channel allocations without promising results.

steps.zh: 確認成本與轉換假設的單位
steps.en: Confirm units for cost and conversion assumptions

steps.zh: 按相同口徑計算各分配情境
steps.en: Calculate allocations on the same basis

steps.zh: 改變關鍵假設，呈現結果差異
steps.en: Vary key assumptions and show the change

input.zh: 示例預算 10,000：A 每次點擊 20、假設轉換率 2%；B 每次點擊 25、假設轉換率 3%。
input.en: Illustrative budget 10,000: A costs 20 per click with assumed 2% conversion; B costs 25 with assumed 3% conversion.

output.zh: 全投 A：500 次點擊、假設 10 次轉換；全投 B：400 次、假設 12 次。若 B 轉換率降至 2%，變成 8 次。這是算式比較，不是成效預測。
output.en: All A: 500 clicks, 10 assumed conversions. All B: 400 clicks, 12 assumed conversions; at 2%, B yields 8. This is scenario arithmetic, not a performance forecast.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准的活動資料與去識別回饋；不自行取得個資或發布內容。
permissions.en: Use approved campaign data and de-identified feedback; do not collect personal data or publish content.

stop.zh: 指標定義不同、成本缺漏或分母為零時不比較；不自動調整投放。
stop.en: Do not compare inconsistent metrics, missing costs or zero denominators; do not change spending automatically.

scenario.zh: 活動數字突然改變，需要先分清追蹤問題與真正變化。
scenario.en: Campaign metrics shift suddenly; tracking issues and real changes need separating.

steps.zh: 對照指標、期間與素材版本
steps.en: Align metrics, periods and creative versions

steps.zh: 標出超出團隊設定範圍的變化
steps.en: Flag changes outside team-defined ranges

steps.zh: 列可能原因與查證順序
steps.en: List possible causes and checks

input.zh: 虛構活動：前一日記錄 40 次轉換，當日 5 次；當日上午剛更換追蹤標籤。
input.en: Fictional campaign: 40 conversions yesterday, 5 today; the tracking tag changed this morning.

output.zh: 觀察：轉換記錄下降，與標籤變更時間相近。先確認追蹤是否正常，再查看流量與訂單；不能直接認定素材失效。
output.en: Observation: recorded conversions fell near a tag change. Check tracking first, then traffic and orders; do not conclude the creative failed.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准的活動資料與去識別回饋；不自行取得個資或發布內容。
permissions.en: Use approved campaign data and de-identified feedback; do not collect personal data or publish content.

stop.zh: 資料尚未更新完整或追蹤有疑慮時，暫停成效歸因並交人確認。
stop.en: With incomplete updates or questionable tracking, withhold attribution and ask for review.

scenario.zh: 團隊想安排會員互動，但要避免打擾與違反同意範圍。
scenario.en: The team wants member outreach without unwanted contact or consent violations.

steps.zh: 先核對聯繫同意與頻率限制
steps.en: Check consent and frequency limits first

steps.zh: 按交易節奏整理可討論情境
steps.en: Group possible situations by purchase patterns

steps.zh: 交付聯繫草案及排除原因
steps.en: Provide outreach drafts and exclusion reasons

input.zh: 虛構會員甲同意 Email，30 天未購買；乙已退訂；政策為每週最多一封。
input.en: Fictional member A permits email and has not purchased for 30 days; B unsubscribed; policy allows one email per week.

output.zh: 甲可列入關懷情境，仍須確認本週是否已寄送。乙列為不可聯繫。沒有購買不等於流失，不自動發信。
output.en: A may be considered after checking this week’s sends. Exclude B. No purchase does not prove churn; no email is sent automatically.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准的活動資料與去識別回饋；不自行取得個資或發布內容。
permissions.en: Use approved campaign data and de-identified feedback; do not collect personal data or publish content.

stop.zh: 同意狀態或頻率紀錄缺漏時不列入可聯繫名單。
stop.en: Do not include members when consent or frequency records are missing.

scenario.zh: 活動準備上線，需要確認內容、追蹤與後續檢討有人負責。
scenario.en: A campaign launch needs owners for content, tracking and review.

steps.zh: 核對簡報、素材版本與核准
steps.en: Check the brief, creative versions and approvals

steps.zh: 驗收追蹤並核准小範圍發布
steps.en: Test tracking and approve a limited release

steps.zh: 依約定期間檢討並記錄下一步
steps.en: Review at the agreed time and record next steps

input.zh: 虛構活動素材已核准，但測試訂單沒有出現在轉換報表。
input.en: A fictional campaign has approved creative, but a test order is absent from the conversion report.

output.zh: 上線檢查：追蹤未驗收，暫不發布；指派分析人員確認。修正並重新驗收後，由負責人核准小範圍上線。
output.en: Launch check: tracking is unaccepted; hold release and assign an analyst. After correction and retest, the owner approves a limited launch.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准的活動資料與去識別回饋；不自行取得個資或發布內容。
permissions.en: Use approved campaign data and de-identified feedback; do not collect personal data or publish content.

stop.zh: 素材未核准或追蹤未驗收就停止發布；擴大預算另需核准。
stop.en: Hold release without content approval or accepted tracking; budget expansion needs separate approval.

scenario.zh: 同樣產量的成本上升，需要先拆開價格與用量影響。
scenario.en: Costs rise at the same output; separate price and usage effects first.

steps.zh: 對齊產量、成本範圍與單位
steps.en: Align output, cost scope and units

steps.zh: 按固定公式分開價格與用量差異
steps.en: Separate price and usage effects with explicit formulas

steps.zh: 列尚未確認的解釋與原始紀錄
steps.en: List unconfirmed explanations and source records

input.zh: 示例同產量：標準用量 100、單價 10；實際用量 110、單價 12。
input.en: Same-output example: standard quantity 100 at price 10; actual quantity 110 at price 12.

output.en: Cost rises from 1,000 to 1,320, a 320 difference. Price effect: (12−10)×110=220; usage effect: (110−100)×10=100. Finance and operations must verify causes.

permissions.zh: 只讀取授權範圍的財務資料；保留計算依據，不執行付款、調帳或對外傳送。
permissions.en: Read authorized financial data only; retain calculation inputs and do not make payments, post adjustments or transmit externally.

stop.zh: 產量或成本口徑不可比時，不直接歸因；先列出需要對齊的資料。
stop.en: With incomparable output or cost scopes, withhold attribution and list required alignment.

scenario.zh: 準備下月付款，需要知道延遲收款可能在哪天形成缺口。
scenario.en: Upcoming payments require understanding when delayed receipts could create a shortfall.

steps.zh: 按日期整理期初餘額與收付款
steps.en: Arrange opening cash and receipts/payments by date

steps.zh: 逐日試算餘額與延遲情境
steps.en: Calculate dated balances and delay scenarios

steps.zh: 標出缺口時間與關鍵假設
steps.en: Flag shortfall dates and assumptions

input.zh: 示例期初現金 100；第 5 天付款 80；第 10 天收款 60；第 12 天付款 90。延遲情境為收款改第 15 天。
input.en: Example opening cash 100; pay 80 on day 5, receive 60 on day 10, pay 90 on day 12. Delayed receipt moves to day 15.

output.zh: 原情境第 12 天餘額 −10；延遲情境為 −70，第 15 天收款後回到 −10。這是假設餘額，調度方式由財務主管決定。
output.en: Base balance on day 12 is −10; delayed receipt produces −70, returning to −10 on day 15. These are hypothetical balances; the finance manager decides funding actions.

permissions.zh: 只讀取授權範圍的財務資料；保留計算依據，不執行付款、調帳或對外傳送。
permissions.en: Read authorized financial data only; retain calculation inputs and do not make payments, post adjustments or transmit externally.

stop.zh: 期初餘額、付款日或幣別未確認時不發布確定缺口；不執行資金調度。
stop.en: Do not finalize shortfalls with unconfirmed opening cash, dates or currencies; do not move funds.

scenario.zh: 實績偏離預算，需要確認是營運改變還是資料口徑改變。
scenario.en: Actuals differ from budget; determine whether operations or definitions changed.

steps.zh: 核對預算版本與實績範圍
steps.en: Check budget version and actual scope

steps.zh: 拆開數值差異與定義差異
steps.en: Separate numerical and definition changes

steps.zh: 列待確認假設及負責人
steps.en: List assumptions to confirm and their owners

input.zh: 虛構預算收入 1,000、實績 900；預算含運費收入，實績報表是否包含尚不明。
input.en: Fictional budget revenue 1,000 and actual 900; budget includes shipping revenue, while actual reporting scope is unclear.

output.zh: 表面差異 −100，先標為未對齊口徑；請財務確認運費收入，再由業務確認數量與單價假設。不能先認定需求下降。
output.en: Apparent difference −100, pending scope alignment. Finance checks shipping revenue; sales checks volume and price assumptions. Do not assume falling demand.

permissions.zh: 只讀取授權範圍的財務資料；保留計算依據，不執行付款、調帳或對外傳送。
permissions.en: Read authorized financial data only; retain calculation inputs and do not make payments, post adjustments or transmit externally.

stop.zh: 版本或指標定義不一致時，暫停更新預測，先完成口徑核對。
stop.en: With inconsistent versions or definitions, hold forecast updates until reconciliation.

scenario.zh: 銷售額沒有下降，獲利卻變少，需要看折扣與費用影響。
scenario.en: Sales hold steady but profit falls; inspect discounts and fees.

steps.zh: 對齊期間與費用是否已包含
steps.en: Align periods and check included expenses

steps.zh: 依核准口徑逐項橋接差異
steps.en: Bridge each difference using approved definitions

steps.zh: 保留可重算的明細
steps.en: Retain a reproducible breakdown

input.zh: 示例比較：收入原為 1,000；本期折扣增加 50，物流費增加 20，其他條件相同；收入以折扣前口徑呈現。
input.en: Example comparison: revenue before discounts is 1,000; discounts rise by 50 and logistics by 20, all else unchanged.

output.zh: 相對基準獲利減少 70：折扣 −50、物流 −20。須確認折扣未在收入中先扣過，避免重複計入。
output.en: Profit falls by 70 relative to the baseline: discounts −50, logistics −20. Confirm discounts were not already netted from revenue to avoid double counting.

permissions.zh: 只讀取授權範圍的財務資料；保留計算依據，不執行付款、調帳或對外傳送。
permissions.en: Read authorized financial data only; retain calculation inputs and do not make payments, post adjustments or transmit externally.

stop.zh: 費用分攤或收入定義不明時先停止合計，交財務確認。
stop.en: Hold totals when allocation or revenue definitions are unclear; ask finance to confirm.

scenario.zh: 財務發現異常金額，希望把疑點連回憑證查證。
scenario.en: Finance finds an unusual amount and needs document-backed checks.

steps.zh: 確認異常項目與允許查詢範圍
steps.en: Confirm the item and permitted query scope

steps.zh: 對照交易、憑證及核准紀錄
steps.en: Compare transactions, documents and approvals

steps.zh: 分開已確認事實與待查假設
steps.en: Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses

input.zh: 虛構明細有兩筆各 500，發票號碼相同，但第二筆沒有核准附件。
input.en: Fictional ledger has two entries of 500 with the same invoice number; the second lacks an approval attachment.

output.zh: 待查：是否重複入帳或分期紀錄？已知：發票號碼相同、附件缺漏。交財務覆核，不直接刪除或判定舞弊。
output.en: Check whether entries are duplicate or installment records. Known: matching invoice numbers and a missing attachment. Refer to finance; do not delete entries or allege fraud.

permissions.zh: 只讀取授權範圍的財務資料；保留計算依據，不執行付款、調帳或對外傳送。
permissions.en: Read authorized financial data only; retain calculation inputs and do not make payments, post adjustments or transmit externally.

stop.zh: 超出權限、原憑證缺失或紀錄矛盾時交回財務，保留未解疑點。
stop.en: Hand back on access limits, missing originals or contradictions; retain unresolved questions.

scope.zh: 僅作既有會計資料存取的研究線索；查證邏輯與權限需另外確認。
scope.en: A lead for accounting-data access only; investigation logic and permissions need separate assessment.

scenario.zh: 付款前需要確認發票、訂單與收貨紀錄是否一致。
scenario.en: Before payment, reconcile invoice, purchase order and receipt records.

steps.zh: 核對文件識別與必要欄位
steps.en: Check document identifiers and required fields

steps.zh: 比較數量與金額並列例外
steps.en: Compare quantities and amounts and list exceptions

steps.zh: 補件覆核後交核准人
steps.en: Resolve exceptions and submit for approval

input.zh: 虛構訂單 10 件、每件 100；收貨 8 件；發票請款 1,000，政策要求收貨數量一致才可送核准。
input.en: Fictional order: 10 units at 100; 8 received; invoice requests 1,000. Policy requires received quantities to match before approval.

output.zh: 差異：發票比收貨多 2 件、金額 200。先請採購與收貨人確認，暫不送付款；核對完成也不等於已授權付款。
output.en: Exception: invoice exceeds receipt by 2 units, amount 200. Ask procurement and receiving to confirm; hold payment submission. Reconciliation is not payment authorization.

permissions.zh: 只讀取授權範圍的財務資料；保留計算依據，不執行付款、調帳或對外傳送。
permissions.en: Read authorized financial data only; retain calculation inputs and do not make payments, post adjustments or transmit externally.

stop.zh: 疑似重複、數量不符或缺收貨資料就停在例外處理，不自動付款。
stop.en: Route possible duplicates, mismatches or missing receipts to exception review; never pay automatically.

scope.zh: 僅參考發票整理的入口；未驗證三方核對或付款核准。
scope.en: A lead for invoice organization only; three-way matching and payment approval are unverified.

scenario.zh: 招募人員準備面談，需要把履歷證據對照職務需求。
scenario.en: Recruiters preparing an interview need evidence against job requirements.

steps.zh: 確認與工作相關的核准要求
steps.en: Confirm approved job-related requirements

steps.zh: 逐項引用履歷中的支持內容
steps.en: Cite supporting resume content for each requirement

steps.zh: 把未知項改成面談問題
steps.en: Turn unknowns into interview questions

input.zh: 虛構職務需要報表分析；履歷寫「維護每週銷售報表」，沒有說明分析方法。
input.en: A fictional role needs report analysis; the resume states “maintained weekly sales reports” without describing analysis methods.

output.zh: 已提供：報表維護經驗。待確認：如何檢查數字、如何解釋變化。面談可請對方說明一個例子；不做錄取排名。
output.en: Evidence: report maintenance experience. Unknown: numerical checks and interpretation. Ask for an example in interview; do not rank applicants for hiring.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准且必要的人事資料，示例不使用真實個資；不自行調整權限或作人事決定。
permissions.en: Use only necessary, authorized HR data; examples use no real personal data. Do not change access or make employment decisions.

stop.zh: 標準與工作無關、涉及不必要敏感資料或證據不足時，交招募人員確認。
stop.en: Refer unrelated criteria, unnecessary sensitive data or insufficient evidence to the recruiter.

reason.zh: 履歷篩選與面試排程的應用範例
reason.en: Resume screening and interview scheduling example

scope.zh: 僅閱讀招募應用範例；不採用自動錄取決定，也未驗證公平性。
scope.en: A recruitment example to read, not an automated hiring decision; fairness is unverified.

scenario.zh: 主管想安排訓練，先確認實際工作能力有哪些未知。
scenario.en: A manager planning training first needs to identify unknowns in work skills.

steps.zh: 列出任務需要的可觀察能力
steps.en: List observable abilities needed for the task

steps.zh: 對照成果與本人說明
steps.en: Compare work samples and self-reports

steps.zh: 設計可討論的追問題目
steps.en: Draft questions for discussion

input.zh: 虛構員工自述熟悉試算表；成果只有整理過的清單，沒有公式或檢查紀錄。
input.en: A fictional employee reports spreadsheet proficiency; the sample contains a cleaned list but no formulas or checking record.

output.zh: 可確認：曾整理清單。未知：公式使用與核對方法。訪談題：請示範如何找出重複資料。未知不是能力不足的定論。
output.en: Supported: list preparation. Unknown: formulas and checks. Ask for a demonstration of duplicate detection. Unknown is not a finding of incompetence.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准且必要的人事資料，示例不使用真實個資；不自行調整權限或作人事決定。
permissions.en: Use only necessary, authorized HR data; examples use no real personal data. Do not change access or make employment decisions.

stop.zh: 成果無法確認歸屬或要求不清楚時，不給熟練度結論。
stop.en: Do not conclude proficiency with unclear authorship or requirements.

scenario.zh: 工作量增加，主管要估算需要多少可用工時。
scenario.en: Rising workload requires an estimate of usable staff hours.

steps.zh: 核對工作量與每件工時
steps.en: Check volume and hours per item

steps.zh: 扣除已知非處理時間後比較產能
steps.en: Compare capacity after known non-processing time

steps.zh: 呈現假設與缺口情境
steps.en: Show assumptions and gap scenarios

input.zh: 示例每週 100 件、每件 0.5 小時；兩人各有 20 小時可用處理時間。
input.en: Example: 100 cases per week at 0.5 hours each; two people each have 20 processing hours available.

output.zh: 需求 50 小時、可用 40 小時，差 10 小時。若每件需 0.6 小時，差 20 小時。由主管討論工作安排，不直接推定需要增聘幾人。
output.en: Demand is 50 hours versus 40 available, a 10-hour gap; at 0.6 hours per case the gap is 20. Managers discuss arrangements; do not infer a hiring count automatically.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准且必要的人事資料，示例不使用真實個資；不自行調整權限或作人事決定。
permissions.en: Use only necessary, authorized HR data; examples use no real personal data. Do not change access or make employment decisions.

stop.zh: 可用工時或任務尺度未確認時不定案；不能用試算直接安排加班。
stop.en: Do not finalize with unconfirmed available hours or task measures; do not assign overtime from the estimate.

scenario.zh: 能力目標已共同確認，需要安排可實踐的小步驟。
scenario.en: An agreed skill goal needs a practical learning plan.

steps.zh: 確認目標與可投入時間
steps.en: Confirm the goal and available time

steps.zh: 搭配練習、資源與回饋點
steps.en: Pair exercises with resources and feedback

steps.zh: 依成果調整下一步
steps.en: Adjust the next step using work evidence

input.zh: 虛構目標：能自行核對報表；每週可投入 1 小時，目前不熟悉重複資料檢查。
input.en: Fictional goal: check reports independently; one hour is available weekly, with duplicate checks unfamiliar.

output.zh: 第一週用練習清單找重複，第二週說明檢查步驟；主管回饋後再增加難度。完成課程不等於已具備能力。
output.en: Week 1: find duplicates in a practice list. Week 2: explain the checks. Increase difficulty after feedback. Course completion does not establish competence.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准且必要的人事資料，示例不使用真實個資；不自行調整權限或作人事決定。
permissions.en: Use only necessary, authorized HR data; examples use no real personal data. Do not change access or make employment decisions.

stop.zh: 目標未經本人與主管確認、資源不可用或成果不足時，先調整計畫。
stop.en: Revise the plan for unagreed goals, unavailable resources or insufficient learning evidence.

scenario.zh: 新人即將到職，需要把訓練、交接與帳號申請分派清楚。
scenario.en: A new starter needs clear ownership for training, handover and account requests.

steps.zh: 確認角色、到職日與必要任務
steps.en: Confirm role, start date and required tasks

steps.zh: 指派負責人並分開權限核准
steps.en: Assign owners and separate access approval

steps.zh: 追蹤完成與未解問題
steps.en: Track completion and unresolved questions

input.zh: 虛構新人週一到職；訓練由主管負責，報表系統帳號尚未核准。
input.en: A fictional starter joins Monday; the manager owns training, while reporting-system access remains unapproved.

output.zh: 到職表：週一安排訓練；系統帳號標為待核准，指派系統負責人確認。不因到職日期到來就自動開通。
output.en: Checklist: training on Monday; access remains pending with the system owner assigned. The start date does not trigger automatic access.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准且必要的人事資料，示例不使用真實個資；不自行調整權限或作人事決定。
permissions.en: Use only necessary, authorized HR data; examples use no real personal data. Do not change access or make employment decisions.

stop.zh: 權限未核准或交接無負責人時保留未完成，不把清單自動全部勾選。
stop.en: Keep tasks open without access approval or handover ownership; do not mark them complete automatically.

scenario.zh: HR 收到制度適用問題，需要先找正確版本與處理人。
scenario.en: HR receives a policy question and needs the right version and owner.

steps.zh: 確認案件日期、地區與問題範圍
steps.en: Confirm date, location and scope

steps.zh: 定位有效政策與相關版本
steps.en: Locate effective policies and relevant versions

steps.zh: 列矛盾與需專業確認的問題
steps.en: List conflicts and questions for professional review

input.zh: 虛構員工詢問補助；內網有兩版政策，日期不同，新版未寫生效日。
input.en: A fictional employee asks about an allowance; two policy versions have different dates, but the newer file has no effective date.

output.zh: 提供兩版來源與差異，請 HR 確認生效版本及適用對象；暫不回覆是否符合補助資格。
output.en: Provide both sources and differences; HR confirms the effective version and scope. Withhold an eligibility answer.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准且必要的人事資料，示例不使用真實個資；不自行調整權限或作人事決定。
permissions.en: Use only necessary, authorized HR data; examples use no real personal data. Do not change access or make employment decisions.

stop.zh: 有效版本或適用地區不明時停止適用判斷，升級 HR 或法務。
stop.en: Stop applicability judgments when version or location is unclear; escalate to HR or legal.

scenario.zh: 供應商報價格式不同，採購需要整理成同一張表。
scenario.en: Supplier quotes use different formats; procurement needs a consistent table.

steps.zh: 定位品項、價格、單位與條件
steps.en: Locate items, prices, units and terms

steps.zh: 保留原始單位與文件位置
steps.en: Retain original units and document locations

steps.zh: 只轉換已確認的單位，標記缺漏
steps.en: Convert confirmed units only and flag omissions

input.zh: 虛構報價：甲每箱 500、每箱 10 件；乙每件 48，未註明最低量。
input.en: Fictional quotes: A offers 500 per box of 10 units; B offers 48 per unit without a minimum quantity.

output.zh: 甲換算每件 50，保留箱裝條件；乙每件 48、最低量待補問。尚未納入運費，不能只看這個數字決定採購。
output.en: A converts to 50 per unit with box conditions retained; B is 48 with minimum quantity unknown. Shipping is excluded; these figures alone do not justify a purchase.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准的報價與供應商資料；不對外詢價、承諾交易或自動下單。
permissions.en: Use authorized quotes and supplier data only; do not send inquiries, make commitments or place orders automatically.

stop.zh: 文字無法辨識、幣別或單位不明時不猜值，交採購補確認。
stop.en: Do not guess unreadable text, currency or units; request clarification.

reason.zh: 報價文件轉為可處理文字
reason.en: Converting quote documents to processable text

scope.zh: 僅作文件轉文字的入口；欄位辨識、單位與可比性仍需確認。
scope.en: A lead for document-to-text conversion; field extraction, units and comparability need confirmation.

scenario.zh: 單價相近，但付款、交期或保固條件不同。
scenario.en: Similar unit prices come with different payment, delivery or warranty terms.

steps.zh: 以採購需求建立比較欄位
steps.en: Use purchasing requirements as comparison fields

steps.zh: 逐項引用各家條件
steps.en: Cite each supplier’s terms

steps.zh: 標出衝突、未知與需談判事項
steps.en: Flag conflicts, unknowns and negotiation points

input.zh: 虛構需求為 30 天內交貨；甲報 20 天、預付全款；乙報 45 天、收貨後付款。
input.en: Fictional requirement: delivery within 30 days. A offers 20 days with full prepayment; B offers 45 days with payment after receipt.

output.zh: 甲交期符合，但需確認預付是否可接受；乙付款較晚，但交期超出需求 15 天。由採購確認可接受的取捨。
output.en: A meets timing but prepayment needs review; B pays later but exceeds the delivery requirement by 15 days. Procurement evaluates the trade-off.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准的報價與供應商資料；不對外詢價、承諾交易或自動下單。
permissions.en: Use authorized quotes and supplier data only; do not send inquiries, make commitments or place orders automatically.

stop.zh: 條款含義或需求版本不明時先列疑問，不自行解釋成已符合。
stop.en: List questions when terms or requirement versions are unclear; do not mark them compliant.

scenario.zh: 採購要比較含一次性費用的總成本。
scenario.en: Procurement needs to compare total costs including one-time charges.

steps.zh: 確認數量、幣別與已含費用
steps.en: Confirm quantities, currencies and included fees

steps.zh: 計入單價、運費與一次性費用
steps.en: Include unit, freight and one-time costs

steps.zh: 比較數量改變後的結果
steps.en: Compare results at another quantity

input.zh: 同幣別示例：100 件；甲每件 10、運費 100；乙每件 9、一次性費用 300、運費 0。
input.en: Same-currency example: 100 units. A charges 10 per unit plus freight 100; B charges 9 plus a one-time fee 300, with no freight.

output.zh: 100 件：甲 1,100、乙 1,200。300 件：甲 3,100、乙 3,000，假設費用不變。均未含稅；量變後優勢可能改變。
output.en: At 100 units: A 1,100, B 1,200. At 300: A 3,100, B 3,000, assuming fixed fees. Tax is excluded; the comparison changes with volume.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准的報價與供應商資料；不對外詢價、承諾交易或自動下單。
permissions.en: Use authorized quotes and supplier data only; do not send inquiries, make commitments or place orders automatically.

stop.zh: 費用是否已包含或匯率日期不明時，停止合計並確認口徑。
stop.en: Hold totals when fee inclusion or exchange-rate dates are unclear.

scope.zh: 僅參考比較表的試算表操作；不代表已具備此成本模型。
scope.en: A lead for spreadsheet operations, not an established implementation of this cost model.

scenario.zh: 團隊想避免訂單過度集中，同時滿足需求與產能限制。
scenario.en: The team wants less supplier concentration while meeting demand and capacity limits.

steps.zh: 確認合格供應商及限制
steps.en: Confirm eligible suppliers and constraints

steps.zh: 試算幾個分單組合
steps.en: Calculate a few allocation scenarios

steps.zh: 列成本差與不符合的限制
steps.en: Show cost differences and violated constraints

input.zh: 示例需求 100 件；甲單價 10、產能 80；乙單價 11、產能 60；政策限制單一供應商最多 70%。
input.en: Example demand 100 units: A costs 10 with capacity 80; B costs 11 with capacity 60. Policy caps each supplier at 70%.

output.zh: 70／30 分單成本 1,030，符合限制；80／20 成本 1,020，但甲占 80%，違反集中度限制。最終由主管決定。
output.en: A/B allocation 70/30 costs 1,030 and meets constraints. 80/20 costs 1,020 but violates concentration limits. The manager decides.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准的報價與供應商資料；不對外詢價、承諾交易或自動下單。
permissions.en: Use authorized quotes and supplier data only; do not send inquiries, make commitments or place orders automatically.

stop.zh: 未確認供應商資格、最低量或限制互相矛盾時，不給可採用結論。
stop.en: Do not label an allocation usable with unconfirmed eligibility, minimums or conflicting constraints.

scenario.zh: 看到供應商事件消息，需要確認是否影響自己的訂單。
scenario.en: A supplier incident needs checking against the company’s actual orders.

steps.zh: 核對事件來源與供應商識別
steps.en: Check event provenance and supplier identity

steps.zh: 對照物料與未交訂單
steps.en: Map materials and open orders

steps.zh: 列曝險與查證任務
steps.en: List exposure and verification tasks

input.zh: 虛構消息指出甲廠停電；本公司物料 X 向甲採購，但訂單沒有記錄實際製造廠。
input.en: A fictional report mentions a power outage at plant A; material X is bought from supplier A, but the order lacks a manufacturing-site record.

output.zh: 可能相關：物料 X 未交訂單。尚不清楚是否由受影響廠供貨；先請採購確認廠別及交期，不直接切換供應商。
output.en: Potential exposure: open material-X orders. Site linkage is unknown; procurement confirms the site and timing before considering a supplier switch.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准的報價與供應商資料；不對外詢價、承諾交易或自動下單。
permissions.en: Use authorized quotes and supplier data only; do not send inquiries, make commitments or place orders automatically.

stop.zh: 只有同名、沒有可靠來源或物料關聯時，不宣稱已確認影響。
stop.en: Do not claim confirmed impact from a shared name, weak source or missing material link.

scenario.zh: 多家詢價與澄清已往返，需要整理同版本的比較包。
scenario.en: Multiple quotes and clarifications need one version-consistent review package.

steps.zh: 確認需求版本與報價完整性
steps.en: Confirm requirement versions and quote completeness

steps.zh: 彙整差異並追蹤澄清
steps.en: Compile differences and track clarification

steps.zh: 交審核人比較並保存決定
steps.en: Submit for review and retain the decision

input.zh: 虛構甲按規格 v2 報價，乙仍按 v1；兩版材料要求不同。
input.en: Fictional supplier A quotes specification v2; B still uses v1 with different material requirements.

output.zh: 比較包標記乙版本不符，先補詢價；未完成前不做單價優劣結論。補齊後交核准人，保留採用理由。
output.en: Flag B’s version mismatch and request an updated quote; withhold a price conclusion until comparable. Submit to the approver with the selection rationale retained.

permissions.zh: 只使用獲准的報價與供應商資料；不對外詢價、承諾交易或自動下單。
permissions.en: Use authorized quotes and supplier data only; do not send inquiries, make commitments or place orders automatically.

stop.zh: 規格不一致或缺澄清紀錄時停在補件；對外承諾與下單另需核准。
stop.en: Hold at clarification for inconsistent specifications or missing records; commitments and orders need approval.

scenario.zh: 案件經常等待或重工，負責人想先看有哪些例外。
scenario.en: Frequent waiting and rework require an initial view of exception types.

steps.zh: 對照標準流程與案件敘述
steps.en: Compare case descriptions with the standard process

steps.zh: 分類等待、補件與重工並附依據
steps.en: Classify waiting, missing documents and rework with evidence

steps.zh: 留下模糊與多重原因
steps.en: Retain ambiguous and multiple possible causes

input.zh: 虛構工單：「等客戶補簽名，昨天退回一次。」沒有說明第一次退回原因。
input.en: Fictional ticket: “Waiting for a customer signature; returned once yesterday.” The first return reason is absent.

output.zh: 可標記：等待補件；重工次數可記為一次，但原因未知。不能直接歸因員工疏失；請流程負責人確認。
output.en: Tag waiting for documents; record one return with cause unknown. Do not attribute employee error; ask the process owner to confirm.

permissions.zh: 只讀取指定流程的工單與排程；不自行更改正式排程、關閉服務或向客戶承諾。
permissions.en: Read tickets and schedules for the assigned process only; do not change official schedules, shut down services or make customer commitments.

stop.zh: 無法對應標準流程或敘述矛盾時，保留待分類，不強行選根因。
stop.en: Keep cases unclassified when process mapping or descriptions are unclear; do not force a root cause.

scenario.zh: 下週進件量可能增加，需要先看處理能力是否足夠。
scenario.en: Expected next-week volume may exceed processing capacity.

steps.zh: 確認進件量、處理時間與可用人力
steps.en: Confirm volume, handling time and available staffing

steps.zh: 按同一期間計算需求與產能
steps.en: Calculate demand and capacity for the same period

steps.zh: 列不同假設下的缺口
steps.en: Show gaps under alternative assumptions

input.zh: 示例每日 60 件、每件 10 分鐘；兩人各有 4 小時處理案件。
input.en: Example: 60 cases daily at 10 minutes each; two people each have 4 processing hours.

output.zh: 需求 600 分鐘、產能 480 分鐘，差 120 分鐘；按平均時間約相當於 12 件工作量。這不是實際延誤預測。
output.en: Demand is 600 minutes versus capacity 480, a 120-minute gap, equivalent to about 12 average cases. This is not a forecast of actual delays.

permissions.zh: 只讀取指定流程的工單與排程；不自行更改正式排程、關閉服務或向客戶承諾。
permissions.en: Read tickets and schedules for the assigned process only; do not change official schedules, shut down services or make customer commitments.

stop.zh: 處理時間定義不一致或忽略必要休息／其他工作時，先修正假設。
stop.en: Revise assumptions for inconsistent time definitions or omitted breaks and other work.

scenario.zh: 臨時插單，需要比較改動對既有承諾的影響。
scenario.en: A rush job requires comparing impacts on existing commitments.

steps.zh: 確認任務時間、依賴與交期
steps.en: Confirm durations, dependencies and deadlines

steps.zh: 比較原排程與插單方案
steps.en: Compare the original and rush-job schedules

steps.zh: 列出延後項目與衝突
steps.en: List postponed tasks and conflicts

input.zh: 示例同一人依序做 A 2 小時、B 2 小時；插入急件 C 1 小時，假設無切換時間。
input.en: One person processes A for 2 hours then B for 2; rush job C takes 1 hour, assuming no switching time.

output.zh: 原方案 A 在第 2 小時、B 在第 4 小時完成；先做 C 時，A 到第 3 小時、B 到第 5 小時。由主管確認延後是否可接受。
output.en: Originally A finishes at hour 2 and B at hour 4. Putting C first moves A to hour 3 and B to hour 5. The supervisor assesses acceptability.

permissions.zh: 只讀取指定流程的工單與排程；不自行更改正式排程、關閉服務或向客戶承諾。
permissions.en: Read tickets and schedules for the assigned process only; do not change official schedules, shut down services or make customer commitments.

stop.zh: 缺少依賴或資源可用時間時不標為可行；正式排程須另行核准。
stop.en: Do not label scenarios feasible with missing dependencies or resource availability; official schedules need approval.

scenario.zh: 同一事件產生多個告警，需要先整理影響與處理優先順序。
scenario.en: Several alerts may describe one incident; consolidate impact and review priorities.

steps.zh: 對齊時間、服務與告警來源
steps.en: Align timestamps, services and alert sources

steps.zh: 將可能相關的訊號放在一起
steps.en: Group potentially related signals

steps.zh: 列已知影響與先確認事項
steps.en: List known impact and first checks

input.zh: 虛構 10:00 出現登入失敗告警，10:02 客服收到無法登入工單；兩者都提到服務甲。
input.en: Fictional login alerts appear at 10:00, followed by support tickets at 10:02; both mention service A.

output.zh: 整理為可能相關事件：服務甲登入異常；影響人數未知。先確認服務狀態與時間範圍，不能直接判定資料外洩。
output.en: Group as a potentially related service-A login incident; affected count is unknown. Check status and time range; do not infer a data breach.

permissions.zh: 只讀取指定流程的工單與排程；不自行更改正式排程、關閉服務或向客戶承諾。
permissions.en: Read tickets and schedules for the assigned process only; do not change official schedules, shut down services or make customer commitments.

stop.zh: 事件關聯不明或涉及安全風險時，保留原告警並交值班主管，不自行關閉服務。
stop.en: Retain original alerts and refer unclear links or security risks to the duty supervisor; do not shut down services.

scenario.zh: 例外案件跨多人處理，需要有人負責追蹤到驗收。
scenario.en: A multi-owner exception needs tracked ownership through acceptance.

steps.zh: 確認影響、負責人與處理範圍
steps.en: Confirm impact, ownership and scope

steps.zh: 記錄處理、核准與待辦
steps.en: Record actions, approvals and open tasks

steps.zh: 依驗收條件確認後結案
steps.en: Close only after checking acceptance criteria

input.zh: 虛構訂單地址錯誤；客服已補地址，但物流尚未確認可改派。
input.en: A fictional order has a wrong address; support supplied the correction, but logistics has not confirmed rerouting.

output.zh: 狀態保持「待物流確認」；指派物流負責人與回覆期限。地址已補不代表改派完成，需確認結果後才結案。
output.en: Keep status “awaiting logistics confirmation”; assign an owner and response deadline. A corrected address does not mean rerouting is complete; confirm before closure.

permissions.zh: 只讀取指定流程的工單與排程；不自行更改正式排程、關閉服務或向客戶承諾。
permissions.en: Read tickets and schedules for the assigned process only; do not change official schedules, shut down services or make customer commitments.

stop.zh: 無負責人、超出處理權限或未達驗收條件時，不自動結案。
stop.en: Do not auto-close without ownership, authority or acceptance evidence.

scope.zh: 僅作任務紀錄的研究線索；責任、核准與驗收規則另行設計。
scope.en: A lead for task records; ownership, approvals and acceptance rules require separate design.

scenario.zh: 換班前，要讓下一班知道還有哪些風險與承諾。
scenario.en: Before a shift change, the next team needs unresolved risks and commitments.

steps.zh: 收集未結案與即將到期事項
steps.en: Collect open cases and upcoming deadlines

steps.zh: 核對最新進度與責任人
steps.en: Check latest progress and owners

steps.zh: 列下一班需要確認的動作
steps.en: List actions for the next shift to confirm

input.zh: 虛構工單甲未結，已承諾 18:00 回覆；紀錄寫零件已到，但未見驗收。
input.en: Fictional ticket A remains open with a promised 18:00 reply; the part arrived, but acceptance is unrecorded.

output.zh: 交接：18:00 前回覆，由下一班指定人員確認驗收。零件到貨與修復完成分開記錄，不把未驗收項目標成完成。
output.en: Handover: reply before 18:00; the next shift assigns acceptance checking. Record arrival separately from completed repair; do not mark unaccepted work complete.

permissions.zh: 只讀取指定流程的工單與排程；不自行更改正式排程、關閉服務或向客戶承諾。
permissions.en: Read tickets and schedules for the assigned process only; do not change official schedules, shut down services or make customer commitments.

stop.zh: 負責人或緊急事項未確認時標為待交接，請雙方確認。
stop.en: Mark handover pending when ownership or urgent items are unclear and request both sides’ confirmation.

scenario.zh: 客戶只說「不能用」，客服需要先把問題問清楚。
scenario.en: A customer says “it does not work”; support needs a clearer case.

steps.zh: 分開症狀、版本、影響與已試步驟
steps.en: Separate symptoms, version, impact and attempted steps

steps.zh: 保留客戶原話與未知欄位
steps.en: Retain customer wording and unknown fields

steps.zh: 提出下一輪必要問題
steps.en: Draft essential follow-up questions

input.zh: 虛構工單：「今天打不開報表，昨天可以，已重登。」未提供版本或錯誤訊息。
input.en: Fictional ticket: “Reports will not open today; worked yesterday; tried signing in again.” Version and error message are missing.

output.zh: 已知：報表開啟失敗、曾重登。追問：使用哪個版本？錯誤訊息是什麼？影響一人還是多人？不補猜成系統故障。
output.en: Known: report opening fails; sign-in retried. Ask for version, error message and affected users. Do not invent a system outage.

permissions.zh: 只讀取經授權的客戶案件與有效知識；遮蔽無關個資，不自行回覆、補償或更改服務權益。
permissions.en: Read authorized cases and effective knowledge only; mask unrelated personal data and do not send replies, grant compensation or alter entitlements.

stop.zh: 資料不足時提出補問，不假設已掌握症狀或根因。
stop.en: Ask for clarification when information is insufficient; do not assume symptoms or causes.

scope.zh: 僅作工單資料操作的線索；不代表已完成案件理解。
scope.en: A lead for ticket-data operations, not an established case-understanding implementation.

scenario.zh: 案件需要分派，但規則命中或資料缺漏要能看懂。
scenario.en: Cases need routing with understandable rule matches and missing-data flags.

steps.zh: 確認案件欄位與有效分流規則
steps.en: Check case fields and effective routing rules

steps.zh: 逐項比對優先級與團隊條件
steps.en: Apply priority and team rules explicitly

steps.zh: 列衝突與人工例外
steps.en: List conflicts and manual exceptions

input.zh: 示例規則：多人無法登入交技術組優先處理；工單只寫一人報告，影響範圍未知。
input.en: Example rule: widespread login failures go to technical support with priority; the ticket has one reporter and an unknown affected scope.

output.zh: 建議先補問影響人數；不能把一位報告者等同只有一人受影響。若確認多人，再依該條規則分流。
output.en: Ask how many users are affected; one reporter does not establish one affected user. Route under the rule after confirming wider impact.

permissions.zh: 只讀取經授權的客戶案件與有效知識；遮蔽無關個資，不自行回覆、補償或更改服務權益。
permissions.en: Read authorized cases and effective knowledge only; mask unrelated personal data and do not send replies, grant compensation or alter entitlements.

stop.zh: 必要欄位缺漏、規則衝突或重大安全案件時交人工，不硬給優先級。
stop.en: Refer missing required fields, conflicting rules or major safety cases to a person; do not force a priority.

scenario.zh: 客戶詢問是否包含服務，需要核對有效合約與規則。
scenario.en: A customer asks whether support is included; check valid contracts and rules.

steps.zh: 確認客戶、合約期間與產品版本
steps.en: Confirm customer, contract period and product version

steps.zh: 對照已核准的權益條件
steps.en: Check approved entitlement conditions

steps.zh: 提供依據或無法判定原因
steps.en: Provide the basis or reason no determination is possible

input.zh: 虛構合約包含版本 A 的標準支援至 12/31；案件日期為 11/5，但客戶使用版本未填。
input.en: A fictional contract covers standard support for version A through Dec 31; the case is dated Nov 5, but product version is missing.

output.zh: 期間符合，版本待確認；暫不能判定此案件是否包含。請客服補版本並核對，不擴大承諾其他服務。
output.en: The date is in range, but version is unknown. Withhold a case-level conclusion; support confirms version without promising additional services.

permissions.zh: 只讀取經授權的客戶案件與有效知識；遮蔽無關個資，不自行回覆、補償或更改服務權益。
permissions.en: Read authorized cases and effective knowledge only; mask unrelated personal data and do not send replies, grant compensation or alter entitlements.

stop.zh: 客戶識別、有效合約或必要規則缺漏時停止判定。
stop.en: Stop determination when identity, valid contracts or required rules are missing.

scenario.zh: 案件已澄清，需要從有效知識整理客服回覆草稿。
scenario.en: A clarified case needs a response draft grounded in effective knowledge.

steps.zh: 核對案件與適用版本
steps.en: Check the case and applicable version

steps.zh: 引用核准知識並整理步驟
steps.en: Cite approved knowledge and draft steps

steps.zh: 標示未知，交客服覆核
steps.en: Flag unknowns and submit for support review

input.zh: 虛構案件為版本 A 匯出失敗；核准文件 K-01 寫「先確認日期範圍，不超過 30 天」。
input.en: Fictional case: export fails in version A; approved document K-01 says to check that the date range does not exceed 30 days.

output.zh: 回覆草稿：請先確認日期範圍是否超過 30 天。來源 K-01；若仍失敗，補問錯誤訊息。不保證此步驟一定解決。
output.en: Draft: check whether the date range exceeds 30 days. Cite K-01; if failure persists, ask for the error message. Do not guarantee resolution.

permissions.zh: 只讀取經授權的客戶案件與有效知識；遮蔽無關個資，不自行回覆、補償或更改服務權益。
permissions.en: Read authorized cases and effective knowledge only; mask unrelated personal data and do not send replies, grant compensation or alter entitlements.

stop.zh: 找不到有效來源、文件衝突或涉及安全／重大補償時，停止確定回答並轉人工。
stop.en: Withhold definitive answers for missing or conflicting sources, safety issues or major compensation; hand over to a person.

scenario.zh: 主管要回顧客服互動，找出漏問與承諾的具體片段。
scenario.en: A supervisor reviews support interactions for concrete omissions and commitments.

steps.zh: 確認核准準則與對話範圍
steps.en: Confirm approved criteria and conversation scope

steps.zh: 逐項引用支持觀察的片段
steps.en: Cite excerpts supporting each observation

steps.zh: 區分可確認與需看語境的項目
steps.en: Separate clear observations from context-dependent items

input.zh: 虛構對話：客戶問處理時程，客服回答「我再確認」，未約定回覆時間；準則要求確認追蹤時間。
input.en: Fictional exchange: a customer asks for timing; support says “I will check” without a follow-up time. The review criterion requires an agreed follow-up.

output.zh: 觀察：此片段未見約定回覆時間。建議覆核完整對話是否另有承諾；不能僅據此認定整體服務品質或作人員處分。
output.en: Observation: no follow-up time appears in this excerpt. Check the full conversation for other commitments; do not infer overall quality or impose personnel consequences.

permissions.zh: 只讀取經授權的客戶案件與有效知識；遮蔽無關個資，不自行回覆、補償或更改服務權益。
permissions.en: Read authorized cases and effective knowledge only; mask unrelated personal data and do not send replies, grant compensation or alter entitlements.

stop.zh: 對話不完整或準則版本不明時標為待覆核，不產生人員評等。
stop.en: Flag incomplete conversations or unclear criteria for review; do not produce staff ratings.

scenario.zh: 客訴涉及跨組處理，需要追蹤核准與對客承諾。
scenario.en: A complaint spans teams and needs tracked approvals and commitments.

steps.zh: 確認風險、責任人與回覆期限
steps.en: Confirm risk, owner and response deadline

steps.zh: 把需要核准的處置送審
steps.en: Submit proposed actions for approval

steps.zh: 追蹤回覆、承諾與結案確認
steps.en: Track replies, commitments and closure confirmation

input.zh: 虛構客戶要求退款；客服無退款權限，已承諾隔天回覆，但財務尚未核准。
input.en: A fictional customer requests a refund; support has no refund authority, promised a next-day reply, and finance approval is pending.

output.zh: 升級財務核准，保留隔天回覆待辦。可回覆處理進度，不能先承諾退款成功；完成核准與後續確認後再結案。
output.en: Escalate for finance approval and retain the next-day reply task. Provide status without promising approval; close after authorization and follow-up confirmation.

permissions.zh: 只讀取經授權的客戶案件與有效知識；遮蔽無關個資，不自行回覆、補償或更改服務權益。
permissions.en: Read authorized cases and effective knowledge only; mask unrelated personal data and do not send replies, grant compensation or alter entitlements.

stop.zh: 補償未核准、重大風險或期限將到卻無負責人時升級，不自行結案。
stop.en: Escalate unapproved compensation, major risk or an imminent deadline without an owner; do not self-close.

reason.zh: 客戶對話與聯絡資料操作

scope.zh: 僅參考客戶對話與聯絡資料操作；升級與核准流程未驗證。
scope.en: A lead for conversation/contact operations; escalation and approval flows are unverified.

scenario.zh: 預測與實際數字不同，要先分清需求與出貨的差別。
scenario.en: Forecast and actual figures differ; distinguish demand from shipments first.

steps.zh: 確認預測版本、期間與需求定義
steps.en: Confirm forecast version, period and demand definition

steps.zh: 對照訂單、出貨與缺貨紀錄
steps.en: Compare orders, shipments and stockouts

steps.zh: 分開計算偏差與可比性限制
steps.en: Separate numerical variance from comparability limits

input.zh: 虛構某週預測 100 件，訂單 110 件，缺貨下只出貨 80 件。
input.en: Fictional week: forecast 100 units, orders 110, but stockouts limit shipments to 80.

output.zh: 若以該週訂單為需求，低估 10 件；若只看出貨會誤認高估 20 件。仍須確認重複或取消訂單，不能直接把出貨當完整需求。
output.en: Using that week’s orders as demand gives a 10-unit underforecast; shipments alone suggest a misleading 20-unit overforecast. Check duplicates and cancellations before finalizing demand.

permissions.zh: 只讀取指定物料、批次與貨件的授權資料；不自動下單、改線、放行批次或修改正式版本。
permissions.en: Read authorized data for assigned materials, batches and shipments only; do not place orders, reroute, release batches or change official versions.

stop.zh: 版本、期間或缺貨紀錄不足時，保留分析限制，不發布確定偏誤結論。
stop.en: With unclear versions, periods or stockouts, state limits and withhold a definitive bias conclusion.

scenario.zh: 某據點可能缺貨，另一據點有庫存，要比較補貨與調撥。
scenario.en: One location may run short while another has stock; compare replenishment and transfer.

steps.zh: 核對可用庫存、需求與交期
steps.en: Check available inventory, demand and lead times

steps.zh: 比較補貨、調撥與不處理的影響
steps.en: Compare replenishment, transfer and no-action scenarios

steps.zh: 列成本與其他據點的缺貨風險
steps.en: List cost and stockout risk at other locations

input.zh: 示例甲庫存 20、需求 50；乙庫存 60、需求 20。調撥 30 件總運費 90，隔日到；新補貨需 7 天。
input.en: Example: A has 20 units for demand 50; B has 60 for demand 20. Transferring 30 costs 90 total and arrives next day; replenishment takes 7 days.

output.zh: 調撥後甲 50、乙 30，可涵蓋上述需求；另比較補貨晚到的影響。仍未含需求波動或預留庫存，需主管確認。
output.en: After transfer A has 50 and B 30, covering stated demand. Compare the impact of later replenishment. Demand variation and reserved stock still need review.

permissions.zh: 只讀取指定物料、批次與貨件的授權資料；不自動下單、改線、放行批次或修改正式版本。
permissions.en: Read authorized data for assigned materials, batches and shipments only; do not place orders, reroute, release batches or change official versions.

stop.zh: 庫存是否預留、交期或服務要求不明時，不把方案標為可採用。
stop.en: Do not label scenarios usable when reservations, lead times or service requirements are unclear.

scope.zh: 僅作物流與庫存操作的閱讀線索；此調撥模型與整合未驗證。
scope.en: A reading lead for logistics/inventory operations; this transfer model and integration are unverified.

scenario.zh: 發現品質異常，需要縮小要追查的材料與生產批次。
scenario.en: A quality issue requires narrowing the material and production batches to investigate.

steps.zh: 核對缺陷與批次識別
steps.en: Check defect and batch identifiers

steps.zh: 連接材料、製程與生產批次紀錄
steps.en: Link material, process and production records

steps.zh: 列可能受影響範圍與缺證據處
steps.en: List potentially affected scope and evidence gaps

input.zh: 虛構不良品來自 P1、P2，兩批都使用材料 M7；P3 也用 M7，但尚無檢測結果。
input.en: Fictional defects occur in P1 and P2, both using material M7. P3 also uses M7 but lacks test results.

output.zh: P1、P2 有已知缺陷；P3 列待檢查，不直接判為不良。共同材料只是查證線索，根因與隔離範圍由品質人員確認。
output.en: P1 and P2 have known defects; flag P3 for checking, not as defective. Shared material is a lead; quality staff establish cause and containment scope.

permissions.zh: 只讀取指定物料、批次與貨件的授權資料；不自動下單、改線、放行批次或修改正式版本。
permissions.en: Read authorized data for assigned materials, batches and shipments only; do not place orders, reroute, release batches or change official versions.

stop.zh: 批次關係缺漏或識別無法確認時，不宣稱追溯完整，也不自行放行。
stop.en: Do not claim complete traceability or release products when batch links or identifiers are missing.

scenario.zh: 貨件沒有如期更新，物流需要整理風險與確認選項。
scenario.en: A shipment misses an update; logistics needs risks and confirmation options.

steps.zh: 核對最近里程碑與資料時間
steps.en: Check the latest milestone and update time

steps.zh: 對照預計交期與已取得異常
steps.en: Compare due dates and obtained exception reports

steps.zh: 列待詢問事項與行動選項
steps.en: List questions and possible actions

input.zh: 虛構貨件原訂 5 日到港；最新紀錄停在 3 日出發，5 日仍未更新，未取得新 ETA。
input.en: Fictional shipment is due in port on the 5th; its latest record is departure on the 3rd, with no new ETA on the 5th.

output.zh: 風險：可能延誤，也可能是資料未更新。先向承運人確認位置與 ETA；加急或改線僅列選項，不自行承諾新交期。
output.en: Risk: delay or a stale feed. Confirm location and ETA with the carrier; list expediting or rerouting as options without promising a new date.

permissions.zh: 只讀取指定物料、批次與貨件的授權資料；不自動下單、改線、放行批次或修改正式版本。
permissions.en: Read authorized data for assigned materials, batches and shipments only; do not place orders, reroute, release batches or change official versions.

stop.zh: 無法確認消息來源或貨件識別時，停止確定延誤判斷並交物流確認。
stop.en: With unclear source or shipment identity, withhold a definitive delay finding and refer to logistics.

scope.zh: 僅作供應鏈風險資訊的研究線索；特定貨件關聯與 ETA 能力未驗證。
scope.en: A lead for supply-chain risk information; shipment linkage and ETA capabilities are unverified.

scenario.zh: 工程變更後，要確認供應商與現場使用同一核准版本。
scenario.en: An engineering change requires suppliers and operations to use the approved version.

steps.zh: 核對變更單與核准版本
steps.en: Check the change order and approved version

steps.zh: 比對圖面、BOM 與收悉紀錄
steps.en: Compare drawings, BOM and receipt acknowledgments

steps.zh: 追蹤未同步項目與切換核准
steps.en: Track unsynchronized items and cutover approval

input.zh: 虛構圖面 v3 已核准，供應商回覆收悉的附件仍是 v2，BOM 尚待確認。
input.en: Fictional drawing v3 is approved, but the supplier acknowledges a v2 attachment; BOM alignment is unconfirmed.

output.zh: 未同步清單：供應商附件、BOM 版本。請工程與供應鏈確認，暫不標記 v3 切換完成，也不只靠發信紀錄當作收悉。
output.en: Open items: supplier attachment and BOM version. Engineering and supply chain confirm; do not mark the v3 cutover complete or equate sending with acknowledgment.

permissions.zh: 只讀取指定物料、批次與貨件的授權資料；不自動下單、改線、放行批次或修改正式版本。
permissions.en: Read authorized data for assigned materials, batches and shipments only; do not place orders, reroute, release batches or change official versions.

stop.zh: 版本衝突、缺核准或未確認切換時間時，停止正式切換。
stop.en: Hold official cutover for version conflicts, missing approval or an unconfirmed switch date.

scenario.zh: 長交期材料需要提前準備，但也怕需求變動造成過量。
scenario.en: Long-lead materials need advance planning without ignoring excess-stock risk.

steps.zh: 依確認版本 BOM 展開材料需求
steps.en: Expand demand using the confirmed BOM

steps.zh: 扣除可用庫存與準時到貨在途
steps.en: Subtract usable stock and on-time inbound material

steps.zh: 比較需求改變後的缺口與過量
steps.en: Compare shortages and excess under changed demand

input.zh: 示例需求 100 件成品，每件用材料 2 件；可用庫存 80、準時在途 40。低需求情境為成品 60 件。
input.en: Example: 100 finished units require 2 material units each; usable stock is 80 and on-time inbound is 40. Low demand is 60 finished units.

output.zh: 基準材料需求 200、現有加在途 120，缺口 80；低需求只需 120，缺口為 0。若多備 80，在低需求下會剩 80，未含損耗與安全庫存。
output.en: Base need 200 minus 120 available/inbound leaves 80. Low demand needs 120, leaving no gap. Buying 80 would leave 80 in the low case; scrap and safety stock are excluded.

permissions.zh: 只讀取指定物料、批次與貨件的授權資料；不自動下單、改線、放行批次或修改正式版本。
permissions.en: Read authorized data for assigned materials, batches and shipments only; do not place orders, reroute, release batches or change official versions.

stop.zh: BOM 版本、在途到貨日或預留量不明時，不形成正式採購建議。
stop.en: Do not finalize purchasing recommendations with unclear BOM versions, inbound dates or reservations.

scenario.zh: 收到合約新版，需要讓法務快速看到偏離範本的地方。
scenario.en: A new contract version needs a focused comparison against the approved template.

steps.zh: 確認範本與待審版本
steps.en: Confirm template and review versions

steps.zh: 逐條標出新增、刪除與變更
steps.en: Mark additions, deletions and changes by clause

steps.zh: 附原文並列需法務確認的問題
steps.en: Attach excerpts and questions for legal review

input.zh: 虛構範本付款條件為 30 天；新稿改 60 天，其他條文尚未完成比對。
input.en: Fictional template specifies net 30; the draft changes it to net 60, while other clauses remain unchecked.

output.zh: 已知偏離：付款延後 30 天，附兩版原文；請法務與財務確認是否可接受。不能因此說整份合約已審閱通過。
output.en: Known deviation: payment extends by 30 days, with both excerpts attached. Legal and finance assess acceptability; this does not mean the whole contract is approved.

permissions.zh: 只讀取獲准的合約與內控文件，限制機密與個資範圍；不自行對外發文、接受條款或出具法律結論。
permissions.en: Read approved contracts and control documents within confidentiality and privacy limits; do not send external messages, accept terms or issue legal conclusions.

stop.zh: 找不到有效範本、附件或版本時，不宣稱完成比對或合約可接受。
stop.en: Do not claim complete review or acceptability without the effective template, attachments or versions.

reason.zh: 合約與法律工作指引集合

scope.zh: 僅作合約工作方法的參考；不構成專業審閱或法律結論。
scope.en: A lead for contract-work methods; not professional review or a legal conclusion.

scenario.zh: 已簽合約有多項通知與交付要求，需要建立可核對清單。
scenario.en: A signed contract has delivery and notice duties needing a checkable list.

steps.zh: 收集有效合約、附件與修訂
steps.en: Collect effective contracts, attachments and amendments

steps.zh: 抽出責任人、觸發條件與期限原文
steps.en: Extract owners, triggers and deadline wording

steps.zh: 把不明處交責任人確認
steps.en: Send ambiguities to the responsible reviewer

input.zh: 虛構條款：「驗收後 5 個工作日內提交報告。」紀錄只有交付日，尚無驗收日。
input.en: Fictional clause: “Submit the report within 5 business days after acceptance.” Only delivery, not acceptance, is recorded.

output.zh: 義務草稿：提交報告；起算點為驗收；期限待驗收日與工作日規則確認。交付日不能自動當驗收日。
output.en: Draft duty: submit the report; trigger is acceptance; deadline awaits acceptance date and business-day rules. Delivery is not automatically acceptance.

permissions.zh: 只讀取獲准的合約與內控文件，限制機密與個資範圍；不自行對外發文、接受條款或出具法律結論。
permissions.en: Read approved contracts and control documents within confidentiality and privacy limits; do not send external messages, accept terms or issue legal conclusions.

stop.zh: 附件缺漏、修訂衝突或觸發條件不明時，不產生確定履約期限。
stop.en: Withhold definitive deadlines for missing attachments, conflicting amendments or unclear triggers.

scenario.zh: 義務已確認，需要依約定規則試算提醒日期。
scenario.en: Confirmed duties need reminder dates calculated under agreed rules.

steps.zh: 確認起算日、時區與計日規則
steps.en: Confirm trigger date, timezone and counting rules

steps.zh: 依提供的行事曆計算
steps.en: Calculate using the supplied calendar

steps.zh: 呈現期限與提醒建議供核對
steps.en: Present deadlines and reminders for checking

input.zh: 虛構規則：起算日不計，次日起算 3 個日曆日；起算日 11/5，同一時區，提醒在期限前一天。
input.en: Fictional rule: exclude trigger day and count 3 calendar days from the next day; trigger Nov 5, one timezone; remind one day before the deadline.

output.zh: 依上述規則：期限 11/8，提醒 11/7。保留起算方式供負責人確認；提醒日期不是已履約證明。
output.en: Under that rule: deadline Nov 8, reminder Nov 7. Retain the counting basis for owner confirmation; a reminder is not evidence of performance.

permissions.zh: 只讀取獲准的合約與內控文件，限制機密與個資範圍；不自行對外發文、接受條款或出具法律結論。
permissions.en: Read approved contracts and control documents within confidentiality and privacy limits; do not send external messages, accept terms or issue legal conclusions.

stop.zh: 工作日行事曆、時區或起算規則不明時停止計算，不自行套用法律規則。
stop.en: Stop for unclear business calendars, timezones or counting rules; do not invent legal rules.

scenario.zh: 公司取得新版規範，想知道哪些流程需要請法務檢查。
scenario.en: A new rule document requires identifying processes for legal review.

steps.zh: 確認新舊文件版本與適用範圍
steps.en: Confirm versions and stated scope

steps.zh: 引用差異並連到公司流程
steps.en: Cite changes and link relevant internal processes

steps.zh: 列可能影響與專業確認事項
steps.en: List possible impacts and professional review questions

input.zh: 虛構規範舊版要求每年更新資料，新版文字改為每半年；公司的流程表仍是一年一次，生效日待確認。
input.en: A fictional rule changes annual updates to every six months; the internal schedule remains annual and the effective date is unconfirmed.

output.zh: 可能影響：更新頻率與負責人安排。請法務確認適用性、生效日與過渡安排，再決定是否調整流程。此為虛構規範，不描述現行法規。
output.en: Possible impact: update frequency and ownership. Legal confirms applicability, effective date and transition before changing the process. This fictional rule does not describe current law.

permissions.zh: 只讀取獲准的合約與內控文件，限制機密與個資範圍；不自行對外發文、接受條款或出具法律結論。
permissions.en: Read approved contracts and control documents within confidentiality and privacy limits; do not send external messages, accept terms or issue legal conclusions.

stop.zh: 來源、版本或適用性未確認時，不聲稱公司已違規或必須立即改動。
stop.en: Do not claim noncompliance or mandatory immediate change without confirmed source, version and applicability.

reason.zh: 法律研究與合約分析的 Agent 團隊範例
reason.en: Agent team example for legal research and contract analysis

scope.zh: 僅閱讀法律研究 Agent 範例；規範更新、適用性及公司流程對應未驗證。
scope.en: A legal-research agent example to read; rule updates, applicability and internal-process mapping are unverified.

scenario.zh: 內控覆核需要把每項要求連到實際執行證據。
scenario.en: Control review needs each requirement linked to execution evidence.

steps.zh: 確認控制要求、期間與證據規則
steps.en: Confirm control requirements, period and evidence rules

steps.zh: 整理來源並核對缺漏
steps.en: Index sources and check omissions

steps.zh: 補件後由稽核覆核留痕
steps.en: Resolve gaps and retain the auditor’s review

input.zh: 虛構控制要求付款前核准；附件有核准截圖，但無日期與案件識別。
input.en: A fictional control requires approval before payment; an approval screenshot has neither date nor case identifier.

output.zh: 證據索引列為待補：案件識別、核准時間、對應付款時間。不能只因有截圖就判定控制有效，交稽核確認充分性。
output.en: Mark gaps: case identity, approval time and matching payment time. A screenshot alone does not prove control effectiveness; the auditor assesses sufficiency.

permissions.zh: 只讀取獲准的合約與內控文件，限制機密與個資範圍；不自行對外發文、接受條款或出具法律結論。
permissions.en: Read approved contracts and control documents within confidentiality and privacy limits; do not send external messages, accept terms or issue legal conclusions.

stop.zh: 來源無法回查、關鍵時間缺漏或證據互相矛盾時，不標記控制通過。
stop.en: Do not mark a control passed with untraceable sources, missing key dates or contradictory evidence.

scenario.zh: 商務與法務往返很多，需要整理爭點與待決事項。
scenario.en: Many business/legal exchanges need a concise issue and decision brief.

steps.zh: 對齊合約版本與往來時間
steps.en: Align contract versions and correspondence dates

steps.zh: 分開已知事實、各方立場與假設
steps.en: Separate facts, positions and assumptions

steps.zh: 列待決事項及對應依據
steps.en: List pending decisions with supporting sources

input.zh: 虛構客戶要求 60 天付款，商務希望月底簽約；財務未確認是否可接受，合約仍寫 30 天。
input.en: A fictional customer requests net 60; sales wants a month-end signature; finance has not agreed and the contract still says net 30.

output.zh: 爭點：付款期限。客戶立場為 60 天、商務目標為月底簽約；內部尚未核准讓步。請法務與財務確認，不把目標寫成承諾。
output.en: Issue: payment term. Customer seeks 60 days; sales targets month-end signing; concessions are unapproved. Ask legal and finance; do not present goals as commitments.

permissions.zh: 只讀取獲准的合約與內控文件，限制機密與個資範圍；不自行對外發文、接受條款或出具法律結論。
permissions.en: Read approved contracts and control documents within confidentiality and privacy limits; do not send external messages, accept terms or issue legal conclusions.

stop.zh: 談判立場未核准、版本衝突或缺關鍵往來時，不產生可直接對外發送的文字。
stop.en: Do not provide send-ready external language with unapproved positions, conflicting versions or missing correspondence.

scenario.zh: 外部或內部情況改變，需要重新檢查原策略的假設。
scenario.en: Changed conditions require revisiting the assumptions behind a strategy.

steps.zh: 找出原假設與支持依據
steps.en: Identify original assumptions and support

steps.zh: 對照新資訊並保留來源
steps.en: Compare new information with sources retained

steps.zh: 分開成立、受挑戰與未知
steps.en: Separate supported, challenged and unknown assumptions

input.zh: 虛構策略假設導入需 2 週；最近三案實際用了 4、5、4 週，但案件範圍未確認一致。
input.en: A fictional strategy assumes 2-week onboarding; three recent cases took 4, 5 and 4 weeks, with scope comparability unconfirmed.

output.zh: 假設受到挑戰；先確認案件範圍與延誤原因，再討論是否調整資源。三案不足以證明所有案件都需 4–5 週。
output.en: The assumption is challenged; check scope and causes before discussing resources. Three cases do not establish a universal 4–5-week requirement.

permissions.zh: 只使用核准範圍的策略、專案與決策資料；保留機密限制，不自行核准預算、調整人力或發布決策。
permissions.en: Use approved strategy, project and decision records within confidentiality limits; do not approve budgets, reassign staff or publish decisions automatically.

stop.zh: 原假設版本不明或新證據不可比時標為未知，不自動改策略。
stop.en: Mark unknowns for unclear assumption versions or incomparable evidence; do not change strategy automatically.

scenario.zh: 專案各自合理，但同時進行可能超出共享資源。
scenario.en: Individually reasonable projects may exceed shared capacity when combined.

steps.zh: 核對需求、期間與資源上限
steps.en: Check requirements, periods and resource limits

steps.zh: 比較候選組合及依賴
steps.en: Compare candidate combinations and dependencies

steps.zh: 列未納入專案與取捨
steps.en: List omitted projects and trade-offs

input.zh: 示例本月可用 100 小時；A 要 60、B 要 50、C 要 30；暫不假設效益高低。
input.en: Example: 100 hours available this month; A needs 60, B 50 and C 30; benefits are not ranked.

output.zh: A＋B＝110，超出 10；A＋C＝90，餘 10；B＋C＝80，餘 20。還需確認技能與依賴，不能只靠餘額選組合。
output.en: A+B=110, exceeding by 10; A+C=90, leaving 10; B+C=80, leaving 20. Skills and dependencies still need review; spare hours alone do not determine the choice.

permissions.zh: 只使用核准範圍的策略、專案與決策資料；保留機密限制，不自行核准預算、調整人力或發布決策。
permissions.en: Use approved strategy, project and decision records within confidentiality limits; do not approve budgets, reassign staff or publish decisions automatically.

stop.zh: 工時、預算或依賴尚未核對時，不把組合標為正式承諾。
stop.en: Do not mark combinations committed before reconciling hours, budgets and dependencies.

scenario.zh: 指標偏離目標，需要整理相關專案與決策，供主管追問。
scenario.en: A metric misses target; management needs related projects and decisions for follow-up.

steps.zh: 核對指標定義與資料期間
steps.en: Check metric definition and period

steps.zh: 連接相關專案更新與行動
steps.en: Link relevant project updates and actions

steps.zh: 列有依據的觀察與待確認原因
steps.en: List supported observations and unconfirmed causes

input.zh: 虛構本月導入目標 10 家，完成 6 家；專案更新寫培訓延後，但沒有列影響哪些客戶。
input.en: Fictional monthly onboarding target is 10 accounts, with 6 complete; an update mentions delayed training without naming affected accounts.

output.zh: 差距為 4 家；培訓延後是查證線索，尚不能當成全部原因。請專案負責人補影響清單與下一步。
output.en: Gap: 4 accounts. Delayed training is a lead, not an established full cause. Ask the project owner for affected accounts and next actions.

permissions.zh: 只使用核准範圍的策略、專案與決策資料；保留機密限制，不自行核准預算、調整人力或發布決策。
permissions.en: Use approved strategy, project and decision records within confidentiality limits; do not approve budgets, reassign staff or publish decisions automatically.

stop.zh: 找不到原紀錄、指標口徑變動或部門說明矛盾時，標出缺口並交主管確認。
stop.en: Flag missing records, changed definitions or contradictory explanations for management review.

scope.zh: 僅作專案任務資料的入口；指標與決策之間的分析需另行設計。
scope.en: A lead for project/task records; analysis linking metrics and decisions requires separate design.

scenario.zh: 團隊已有幾個方案，需要在相同準則下看支持與反對理由。
scenario.en: Several options need supporting and opposing evidence under shared criteria.

steps.zh: 確認決策問題與不可違反限制
steps.en: Confirm the decision question and hard constraints

steps.zh: 同格式整理選項、依據與未知
steps.en: Use one format for options, evidence and unknowns

steps.zh: 列反證與尚未比較的取捨
steps.en: List counterevidence and unexamined trade-offs

input.zh: 虛構選項 A 是自建、B 是採用外部產品；A 可客製但需團隊工時，B 可較快試用但資料部署條件未確認。
input.en: Fictional options: A builds internally; B adopts an external product. A offers customization but needs staff time; B may be trialed sooner, with hosting conditions unknown.

output.zh: 比較項目：投入工時、試用時間、部署限制與維護責任。B 的速度優勢需確認；若不符資料限制，即使快也不能直接採用。
output.en: Compare effort, trial timing, hosting limits and maintenance ownership. Confirm B’s speed advantage; if it fails data constraints, speed does not justify adoption.

permissions.zh: 只使用核准範圍的策略、專案與決策資料；保留機密限制，不自行核准預算、調整人力或發布決策。
permissions.en: Use approved strategy, project and decision records within confidentiality limits; do not approve budgets, reassign staff or publish decisions automatically.

stop.zh: 核心限制或必要證據缺漏時，先列待補資訊，不宣稱已有最佳方案。
stop.en: With missing hard constraints or essential evidence, list gaps instead of claiming a best option.

scenario.zh: 兩個選項分數接近，想知道小幅改權重會不會翻轉結果。
scenario.en: Close option scores require checking whether modest weight changes reverse the result.

steps.zh: 確認準則、評分尺度與權重範圍
steps.en: Confirm criteria, scoring scales and weight ranges

steps.zh: 依各組權重重新計算
steps.en: Recalculate under each weight set

steps.zh: 顯示翻轉與爭議假設
steps.en: Show reversals and disputed assumptions

input.zh: 示例皆為 0–5 分：A 成本 4、速度 2；B 成本 2、速度 5。成本／速度權重先用 50／50，再用 70／30。
input.en: Example scores, all 0–5: A cost 4, speed 2; B cost 2, speed 5. Compare cost/speed weights 50/50 and 70/30.

output.zh: 50／50：A＝3、B＝3.5；70／30：A＝3.4、B＝2.9，排名翻轉。應討論成本與速度取捨，不把分數當客觀勝負。
output.en: At 50/50: A=3, B=3.5. At 70/30: A=3.4, B=2.9; ranking reverses. Discuss cost/speed priorities rather than treating scores as objective winners.

permissions.zh: 只使用核准範圍的策略、專案與決策資料；保留機密限制，不自行核准預算、調整人力或發布決策。
permissions.en: Use approved strategy, project and decision records within confidentiality limits; do not approve budgets, reassign staff or publish decisions automatically.

stop.zh: 評分尺度不一致、權重未核准或硬性限制未檢查時，不輸出採用建議。
stop.en: Do not recommend adoption with inconsistent scales, unapproved weights or unchecked hard constraints.

scenario.zh: 決策執行一段時間後，要回看當初假設與實際結果。
scenario.en: After implementation, review original assumptions against actual outcomes.

steps.zh: 保存原選項、假設與核准理由
steps.en: Retain options, assumptions and approval rationale

steps.zh: 按原定義對照實際結果
steps.en: Compare actual outcomes using original definitions

steps.zh: 記錄失效假設、限制與下次試驗
steps.en: Record failed assumptions, limits and the next experiment

input.zh: 虛構決策原估導入 2 週，實際 4 週；期間新增客製需求，沒有分開記錄額外工時。
input.en: A fictional decision estimated 2-week onboarding; actual duration was 4 weeks, with new customization but no separate effort record.

output.zh: 回顧：原時程未達成；需求變動可能相關，影響大小未知。下次先固定試用範圍並記錄額外工時；保留失敗，不事後改寫原估計。
output.en: Review: the original timeline was missed; scope change may matter, but its effect is unknown. Next time fix pilot scope and log extra effort. Retain the miss rather than rewrite the estimate.

permissions.zh: 只使用核准範圍的策略、專案與決策資料；保留機密限制，不自行核准預算、調整人力或發布決策。
permissions.en: Use approved strategy, project and decision records within confidentiality limits; do not approve budgets, reassign staff or publish decisions automatically.

stop.zh: 缺原決策紀錄或結果口徑不同時，標出不可比較處，不強行歸因成功或失敗。
stop.en: Flag missing decision records or incompatible outcome definitions; do not force success/failure attribution.

reason.zh: 協作頁面互動的應用範例
reason.en: Example of interacting with collaboration pages

scope.zh: 僅參考協作頁面的互動方式；決策紀錄與回顧模型需另行設計。
scope.en: A lead for collaboration-page interaction; decision records and review models need separate design.
